text: Both record the tabling of the 2027 to 2029 Immigration Levels Plan under IRPA s.94 with a first check on 2 Nov 2026. LEVELS-1NOV records TABLED (date and URL) or NOT TABLED with the 30 sitting day window; LEVELS2729 records the tabling date and whether the permanent resident target rises above 380,000. LEVELS-1NOV's own text says it is not a substitute for LEVELS2729. Both kept, under review, nothing removed.

Both test a Schedule 1 listing or a dated refusal for MVH. FA3-MVH-DEC tests a listing Order (P.C. number and date) or a dated public refusal on or before 2 Nov 2026; FA3 tests MVH and RBT2 listed or refused in Schedule 1 by 31 Dec 2026. FA3-MVH-DEC's own text says it does not move the FA3 31 Dec row. Both kept, under review, nothing removed.

See also CHARTER-LIMIT-REG. EA-REFORM covers the Emergencies Act only. CHARTER-LIMIT-REG, entered 25 Oct 2026, covers all federal measures that limit Charter rights (emergency orders, health orders, mandates, regulator statements and government requests). Each is scored on its own date; neither replaces the other. The EA-REFORM entry is not changed.

Canada and the EU signed a treaty framework with the EIB on 30 Oct 2026 (https://www.pm.gc.ca/en/news/backgrounders/2026/10/30/canada-and-european-union-announce-new-alliance-future-create-greater). The framework names no project, so CORRIDOR-FIN-2027 stays open; its test and date are unchanged. MTL-CLOSE-SCORED-20261030 records the summit result.
